section_summary.extract_value: This section presents the conclusion of a study involving college women, focusing on a model that investigates interpersonal and intrapersonal links to body appreciation and its connection to intuitive eating. Body appreciation is highlighted as a central mediational variable, accounting for links from restrictive/critical caregiver eating messages, attachment anxiety, and discrepancy perfectionism to intuitive eating. The study also found that body appreciation did not predict unique variance in depressive symptoms, suggesting it is distinct from negative body image.
